notes.title: Release Game and DLC + Unique Release Day Item + Limited Time Item Shop
notes.notes:
Release
We are finally releasing our game, as well as DLC with rare drop and first day unique item!

DLC
We are happy to announce that we have released our DLC with unique Rare Drop!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081350/Hamster_Combat__Road_to_Whale/
By buying DLC you will instantly get:

 3 keys for locked chests, each of them cost 0.25$ if you buy them separately
 1 DLC chest
 Access to DLC chest drop for playtime, every 3 hours you will get 1 DLC chest with low chance to get Locked Chest Key

DLC Discount
For 2 weeks you will be able to buy DLC with 40% discount, so do not miss your chance to increase your loot, unlock new great items and increase your collection!

 Release Day Unique Drop
We start dropping time limited unique item for release day! For 1 days only you will be able to get special Scientist Hamster just for opening game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/ac4011e81a01f5af7322879f3f442fb57b504113.png

New shop items available only for week
In addition, we start selling time-limited unique poops in our item store, first two of them:

 Samurai Hamster
 Girl Hamster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/e25da910b870d18f97c95cf206c336aafe772347.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/78c1b4a6c77e2f466939fc34ffdb0bee075b171b.png
They will be available for buying for week only!

Unique Item for Beta Testers
We are turning off unique drop for beta testers, now this is only possible to obtain from other players on community market, we are appreciating all beta testers for their feedback and participation! For duration of beta test, we granted 64 beta keys, so only 64 Dull Hamsters exist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/e1ed1afbd5e69ae794fe9be179dd095312074b93.png

Don`t forget to join our discord:
https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png
And join you developer group:
https://i.postimg.cc/Yq8hYprj/b25b6c2bd0578570818bb76830d701e4228ed5f6-full.jpg

notes.title: Uncomming release + Invite to beta test with unique item!
notes.notes:
Release:
We are releasing our game at 11 Jule 2024 8:00 PM GTM+3. On release we will be giving everyone unique item for just logging in a game, this offer will be available for only 1 day after release!

Drops:
We also want to let you know that our game will contain common drop for every 3 hours, and rare drop for every 18 hours, this can be collected without any action and also do not require you to spend that much time in the game.

Beta Access with unique drop:
From this moment we starting to take requests for beta access to our game, with special item for our beta testers.
If you want to take a part you should join our developer group:
https://i.postimg.cc/Yq8hYprj/b25b6c2bd0578570818bb76830d701e4228ed5f6-full.jpg
And message me on steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/id/IWannaSeeYourCry/

Or in our discord channel in special text channel called "beta-requests":
https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png
If you message me on discord please include your steam profile link.

Item for beta testers:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/657ffc95f9f1791f9abd8dbf413e6b3b3ae981de.png

Special item drop for beta testers will be available only before release.

Contacts:
If you have any suggestions or questions feel free message me on steam discussions, discord channel, or on email: gosdevproduction@gmail.com
